reasoning: The skill closes work on a shown result only when the verifier confirms the decision sheet's observable outcome — an ordinary buildable result a command, a test or a plain read already confirms. Here the evidence cannot do that. The goal was 'shorter without costing anything', and the eval, by its own record, carries about two scenarios of producer variance, so 30-vs-29 confirms neither that nothing was lost nor that something was. The artifact is silent on the question it was run to answer. What remains is a judgment between 3.7 KB off the pack's front door and an unmeasurable risk to the front door's behaviour — precisely one of the three cases rule 12/27 reserve for the human, a trade-off no artifact settles. So the Director shows both versions and the eval record, states plainly that the run does not separate them and that a further run cannot either (rerunning for confidence is the same false comfort the measurement already gave), and asks for his word on which version stands. Nothing is committed either way; the row stays open on a real block, not on waiting for him to bless a delivered result.
